question: How are you?
hinataIntro: Take a break from your daily routine and take time to rejuvenate your mind and body!
hinataIntro2: A hidden acupuncture and massage salon in Shonandai
hinataIntroParagraph: In your busy daily life, do you accumulate fatigue and stress without realizing it? Hinata Clinic, located near Shonandai Station, is a popular clinic for women that gently balances the mind and body with the power of acupuncture and massage. It can help with stiff shoulders, back pain, autonomic nervous system disorders, and changes in physical condition due to age -
hinataIntroParagraph2: There are those minor ailments that don't warrant a trip to the hospital, but that keep bothering you. By carefully addressing 'these vague ailments', you can make a big difference in your daily life.
hinataIntroParagraph3: 「I am looking for a reliable acupuncture clinic in Fujisawa」
hinataIntroParagraph4: 「I want to get a relaxing massage in Shonandai」
hinataIntroParagraph5: We continue to be chosen by such people, and patients of all ages visit our clinic. In a warm, 'hinata'-like space, we provide custom-made treatments tailored to each individual's concerns. While receiving treatment, you will also feel relaxed and soothed. We operate by appointment only, and our quiet, private space allows you to consult with peace of mind.
hinataIntroParagraph6: This is a clinic that we would like to welcome anyone looking for high-quality acupuncture and massage in the Shonandai/Fujisawa area.
seasonalLetterParagraph: We have recently renewed the Hinata Clinic website.
seasonalLetterParagraph2: It has been 19 years since we opened in Shonandai, and our treatment methods have continued to improve significantly since we first opened.
seasonalLetterParagraph3: Our goal remains the same: to alleviate and improve various painful symptoms. However, we have striven to improve our techniques every day, aiming to reduce the pain and stimulation of acupuncture and ease the burden on patients receiving treatment.
seasonalLetterParagraph4: Specifically, we use two pillars: 'head acupuncture,' which primarily uses acupressure points and reaction points on the head, and 'fast-acting painless treatment,' which uses only 7 or fewer of the 26 acupressure points on the entire body.
seasonalLetterParagraph5: Although each approach is different, we use gentle acupuncture treatment to maximize each person's immune system, not only curing physical ailments but also aiming to improve constitution, and we carefully treat a wide range of illnesses from acute to chronic.
seasonalLetterParagraph6: The needles used in treatment are made in Japan, so you can be sure they are safe and reliable. They are as thin as a human hair, so you will hardly feel any pain when they are inserted.
seasonalLetterParagraph7: There are pain points (pain-sensing cells) on the human skin. When these points are stimulated, some pain can be felt, but our patients generally say things like, 'I didn't even feel the needles, it was painless' (individual differences may apply), so you can receive treatment with peace of mind.
seasonalLetterParagraph8: In addition, a trusting relationship between the patient and our therapist is also an important point in treatment. We believe that a trusting relationship can maximize the effectiveness of treatment.
seasonalLetterParagraph9: Please feel free to contact us with any questions or concerns you may have!

subTitle: 'From symptomatic treatment to fundamental treatment. Improving your constitution is more important than suppressing pain and discomfort with medicine.'
approach1Paragraph1: Adjusting your whole body from the reaction points in your head
approach1Paragraph2: to recover from fatigue and maintain your body
approach2Paragraph1: In the United States, a country advanced in preventive medicine

approachExplanation1: Our bodies gradually accumulate fatigue and distortion due to our daily lives, work, stress, aging, and other factors. Pain and discomfort are signs that this accumulation is reaching its limit. Acupuncture is a treatment that approaches the root of these disorders and draws out the body's innate natural healing powers. However, the body does not return to normal immediately with a single treatment; it is necessary to gradually restore balance.
approachExplanation2: Therefore, by continuing to visit the hospital and monitoring changes in your physical condition, you can improve your condition at a comfortable pace, which will lead to improvement of symptoms and prevention of recurrence. Just like regular checkups for your car or teeth, our bodies also require maintenance. Rather than rushing to deal with problems after they occur, by taking care of your body on a daily basis, you can prevent major problems.
approachExplanation3: Acupuncture and moxibustion not only relieves symptoms, but also helps to restore a balance between mind and body, helping to create a body that is less prone to fatigue and more resilient to recovery. We encourage you to incorporate regular maintenance into your daily routine as a way to look after your own body. We want to support our patients in facing their own bodies and living better lives. Let's work together to help you feel the changes in your body, effortlessly yet steadily.
memberTitle2: Please feel free to contact us first.
member1Intro5: After raising her children, she took the opportunity to attend a vocational school for acupuncture and moxibustion, obtaining national qualifications as an acupuncturist, moxibustion practitioner, and massage therapist. She then opened Hinata Clinic with her eldest son. Valuing a constant desire to learn, she also obtained a license as a certified psychologist in 2024. She mastered advanced 'head acupuncture,' which uses pressure points and reaction points on the head to treat the whole body. Her treatments, which approach not only the body but also the mind, have been highly praised by many.
member1Intro6: She enjoys nothing more than serving homemade meals to her eight grandchildren.
member1Intro7: Her hobbies are fermented foods, watching movies and traveling.
member2Intro3: During his school days, he was devoted to basketball, and participated in the national tournament as part of his high school team. However, after experiencing an injury himself, he became interested in the world of acupuncture and moxibustion, and has continued to study and practice not only treatment but also the importance of injury prevention and physical maintenance from an athlete's perspective. He has mastered the 'fast-acting painless treatment' invented in the United States, a country with a cutting-edge medical field, and is rare in Japan, making it unique in the world. He contributes to resolving and maintaining the physical concerns of his patients.
member2Intro5: His hobbies are eating, camping, snowboarding

hariOkyu9: n addition, the needles are about the thickness of a hair, so you will hardly feel any pain like you would with an injection needle.If you are resistant to acupuncture, we will not force you to use it, so please feel free to visit us.
hariOkyu10: The acupuncture treatments performed at our clinic involve inserting needles onto the surface of the body, mainly into acupuncture points and reaction points (specific muscles, tendons, and areas of severe pain).
annmaShiatsuMassage2: Improved blood flow for better body regulation
annmaShiatsuMassage3: At our clinic, we use manual techniques such as pushing, pulling, stroking, rubbing, kneading, and tapping to select the amount of stimulation appropriate for each individual's symptoms and physique.
annmaShiatsuMassage4: While Anma and Shiatsu are performed with an awareness of acupuncture points and meridians (pathways connecting acupuncture points), massage is performed along the flow of lymph and blood and the course of muscles.
annmaShiatsuMassage5: In addition, while Anma and Shiatsu provide centrifugal stimulation from the center of the body to the periphery, massage provides centripetal stimulation from the periphery to the center. Both have an effect through tactile stimulation from the skin, which directly affects the circulatory system, including lymphatic vessels and blood vessels, and indirectly affects the internal organs through reflexes in the nervous system.
annmaShiatsuMassage6: Although the techniques and theories differ, they all have one thing in common: they are aimed at treatment and healing. Anma is a manual therapy that originated in China, shiatsu in Japan, and massage in France. Currently, in Japan, Anma, Shiatsu, and Massage are all recognized as a single national qualification.
limpa3: Swelling of the upper and lower thighs after surgery or radiation therapy
limpa4: Lymphedema is a condition in which protein and fluid accumulate in body tissues.
limpa6: ①Primary edema: Caused by underdevelopment of lymph nodes and lymphatic vessels
limpa7: ②Secondary edema: aftereffects of surgery or radiation therapy for breast cancer, uterine cancer, prostate cancer, etc., venous disease, or parasites
limpa8: Because lymphatic flow in the body's tissues is stagnant, the arms and legs experience swelling, fatigue, heaviness, and deep pain. Furthermore, the immune system weakens, making the body more susceptible to inflammation. Swelling can occur immediately after surgery, or it can take five or ten years for symptoms to appear. Symptoms progress slowly, but if proper treatment is not given or inflammation occurs repeatedly, it can progress to elephantiasis.
limpa9: If you experience swelling, it is important to get a diagnosis from a specialist as soon as possible and receive comprehensive physical therapy from a therapist with specialized knowledge and skills.
limpa10: Comprehensive physical therapy includes 'skin care', 'medical lymphatic drainage (massage to drain lymphatic fluid)', 'compression therapy (using elastic bandages and sleeve stockings)', 'exercise therapy', and 'self-care instruction.

yomogi5: Mugwort contains cineole and other essential oil components, which have a warming effect and prevent you from getting cold after a bath. The mysteriously warm feeling that lasts after a mugwort steaming session is largely due to the action of these components.
yomogi6: It is also very good for the skin because of its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, suppressing eczema, pimples, and dryness. Mugwort is used in moxibustion because it is said to be effective for lower back pain and neuralgia.
yomogi7: Mugwort is a well-known herbal medicine. It has many beneficial effects on our bodies. It has been particularly well-received by women in their 30s to late 60s.
biyobari6: Facial acupuncture involves inserting needles into acupressure points on the face and scalp to affect the skin and muscles, promoting blood and lymph flow, eliminating waste products from cells, and delivering nutrients.
biyobari7: It also regulates the secretion of sweat and sebaceous glands, giving the skin moisture, color, and elasticity, improving dry skin, dull complexion, age spots, fine wrinkles, and pimples.It can also tighten and firm the sagging skin, giving you a lifted, slimmer face.
biyobari8: Facial acupuncture uses extremely thin needles, but because the blood vessels in the face are extremely thin, internal bleeding may occur in rare cases. Please be aware of this before undergoing treatment.
shonibari3: Pediatric acupuncture uses blunt or flat needles to rub the whole body and stimulate acupressure points. By stimulating the skin with acupuncture needles, the function of the internal organs and brain is activated, improving immunity and regulating the autonomic nervous system and hormones.
shonibari4: It is effective for symptoms such as colic, crying at night, squealing, frequent crying, irritability, biting, bedwetting, catching colds easily, frequent fevers, convulsions, loss of appetite, diarrhea, constipation, frequent stomach aches, allergies, asthma, and tonsillitis.
shonibari5: There are almost no side effects to worry about (though you may become sleepy in rare cases). Treatment time is 5 to 10 minutes. To improve your constitution, continuous treatment for at least one year is recommended. Treatment can be given to babies from newborn age. The earlier you start, the greater the effect.

patientvoicesSubTitle: Introducing some of the people who have experienced the benefits of treatment
patientvoices1_2: It feels great. I sleep well at night after the treatment.
patientvoices2_2: Symptoms improved. Kindness. Good health advice.
patientvoices3_2: I used to suffer from insomnia, but since I started going to Hinata Clinic, I can now sleep soundly until the morning. I was really surprised.
patientvoices4_2: After the massage, both my legs feel so much better. The acupuncturists are also very kind.
patientvoices5_2: The acupuncturists are easy to talk to and always kind, so I'm always grateful for his help. Personally, I feel more comfortable if they pricks me more in various places, but I think they have their own approaches, so I leave it all to them. They`ve really helped me recover from fatigue and feel refreshed.
patientvoices6_2: I started coming to the clinic because of pain in my neck, shoulders, and back, and I trust the clinic's treatment, which takes into account my past injuries and medical history. I also discovered that I have a severe cold intolerance, and the clinic's staff are paying closer attention to my condition than I ever imagined, so I would like to continue receiving treatment.
patientvoices7_2: It's a shame that acupuncture treatment is so effective yet so little known. This year I almost got hay fever for the first time, but the symptoms didn't get worse. I was asked in detail about my lifestyle and was told that my symptoms were caused by using the computer too much. This was the first time I'd received advice on how to cure my condition from the root.
patientvoices8_2: As my baby was in breech position at 27 and 29 weeks, I was worried that things could get worse, so I went to get some moxibustion. It was my first visit, but the atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and after filling out a questionnaire, I had the moxibustion treatment. When the moxibustion was done on my lower back, I felt some movement inside, which made me think that maybe my baby was responding. The moxibustion wasn't hot, but rather gently warm. Afterwards, I was advised to warm my lower body, as it's not good to keep it cold. After the moxibustion, my previously swollen legs became lighter and the swelling went down, which surprised me. Of course, the ultrasound at my prenatal checkup five days later showed that the breech position had been corrected. I went to get treatment for breech position, but the coldness and swelling also improved, so I was very happy.
patientvoices9_2: Suddenly, I felt a sharp pain in my leg and found it difficult to walk. The pain did not subside even when I rested, so I made up my mind to call an ambulance myself and was taken to a general hospital. The pain continued even after I arrived at the hospital, but the doctor told me that it would heal soon, so I went home without treatment. I went home in such intense pain that I felt like crying. The pain didn't go away even after I got home, so I thought this was bad, and an acquaintance of mine asked me about the pain in my leg, and I went there right away. The doctors at Hinata Clinic carefully asked me about the pain in my leg, and suggested the best treatment plan for me on the spot. I was surprised to feel the pain subside even while I was receiving treatment. Thanks to the doctors' careful treatment and advice, the pain completely disappeared after three visits!
